scope.interactionChannel: real macOS Escape through hidden Lynxtron Menu accelerator

observations.name: physical Escape dismissal
observations.detail: A real Escape key activates the hidden host accelerator, sends a modifier-free renderer-neutral packet, and closes the open Model Picker.

classification.closedProductLoss: Model Picker now closes through a real physical Escape key despite the absence of general renderer key events.
remainingProductLoss: Arrow navigation and Enter selection remain behind the Lynxtron renderer-key event boundary.
missingCoverage: No model selection is claimed in this run.
classification.harnessLoss: Desktop DevTool registration remains unavailable; exact-PID WindowServer frames and process logs are used.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: Escape is captured by a hidden native Menu accelerator and delivered as a normalized packet rather than a renderer DOM key event.
